articles.title: Understanding JavaScript Closures
articles.content: A closure is the combination of a function and the lexical environment within which that function was declared. Closures are useful because they let you associate data (the lexical environment) with a function that operates on that data.
articles.author: Jane Doe

articles.title: A Guide to Responsive Web Design
articles.content: Responsive web design is an approach to web design that makes web pages render well on a variety of devices and window or screen sizes. It ensures that users have a good viewing experience regardless of the device they are using.
articles.author: John Smith
